capture.zh: 哈莫星龙王圣殿（三龙之一）挑战塔西亚，打败获得塔西亚精元（孵化得塔拉）。

strategy_notes.zh: 别用物理攻击（命中低且会被害怕）；带水火草电战斗系的特攻手：丽莎布布祈雨/花草能量循环强化，适度补血，用特攻大招；魔焰猩猩、鲁斯王也可。

engine_notes: unlimited_pp; immune to 寄生/毒/烧伤/冻伤 and to stat drops (免疫弱化技能), 同生共死, 极度冰点.
status_on_attacker fear (physical only): taking physical damage makes the attacker afraid (4399: 非常高几率; techbang: 100%).
foe_accuracy_penalty 30: every skill used against it has its accuracy reduced by 30% (techbang: 任何技能对其命中率降低30%).
always_hit: its own skills always hit (自身技能命中率100%).
魔龙咒 struck twice per turn in the original 3v3 team version (可同时攻击2只精灵，一回合可攻击2次); single-target here.
Known 2010 bug: 龙之结界's text said it lowers the foe's 双攻 but it actually lowered 双防 — the catalog skill follows the text.
Level: 4399 2011 summary says 70级 (techbang only gives a recommended LV100).

skills: species 391's last four at or below Lv70. Solo-fight battle screenshots show 真龙灭世咒 (4399 2010-09-17, 7k7k 2010-07-30) and 龙之结界 (7k7k 2010-07-30); 4399 2010-08-13 names 魔龙咒 and 龙之结界 for the team fight. 狂化龙舞 is named only in TW-server screenshots.
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).

No innate boost, against the 2026-10-21 default: 4399 2010-08-09 血到1/4时有强化，可消除 (a boost at a quarter HP, stat unstated, not yet encoded), in contrast with 塔克林's 天生带强化; no release guide clears a boost first.
source_note: 4399 BOSS page (2010-09-26): 血量10000左右, 免疫寄生/毒/烧伤/冻伤, 免疫弱化, PP无限, 物攻高几率被害怕.
